notes: The schema is vendored byte-for-byte (no normalization needed; it parses and compiles as JSON Schema draft-07, which the reference receiver's Ajv also assumes — the file itself declares no $schema).

Upstream defect: both example messages in the repo's examples/ directory FAIL the schema — they use uppercase UUIDs while every uuid pattern in the schema requires lowercase hex ('^[0-9a-f]{8}-...'). This emulator always emits lowercase UUIDs.
Upstream quirk: identityReport.cargoMaxWeight is typed string despite its description saying 'Max weight of cargo in kg'. Emitted as a string here, schema-faithfully.

Upstream quirk: the current location object names its map reference 'planarDatum' while predictedLocation (path/destinations) names it 'planarDatumUUID'. Both spellings are intentional per the schema and used as-is on the wire.
statusReport.location requires 'angle' (a quaternion) and 'planarDatum' — stricter than the PDF prose suggests; the reference receiver enforces the schema, so this emulator always sends both.
path and destinations declare uniqueItems, so consecutive identical predicted locations would be invalid; the movement model guarantees distinct entries.
